description:
The gc event reports from_space_capacity_bytes (block capacity), not the bytes the process allocated, and nothing reports the budget the trigger compared them with; process_exited reports reduction_yields but not parks, so collections per quantum are unmeasurable for processes that park. Proposal page (approved 2026-11-17): https://claude.ai/artifact/GuEvNK64ZNHh8gDEQkMF3m (Proposal B, step 1).

Done when:
- fz.runtime.gc carries young_bytes (Heap::young_bytes at the collection, by fill) and young_budget (the budget should_gc compared it with).
- process_exited's process carries parks: the quanta that ended parked.
- Tests observe the new fields through telemetry (a heap test for the gc fields, a process test for parks), in sibling _test.rs files.
- The stale comment at runtime/src/process.rs:570 claiming a 'shrink hysteresis (§6.5)' that no code implements is replaced by the present fact.
- .agent/docs and guides that list gc/process_exited telemetry fields are updated in the same commit.
- Full gate green. Commit in Why / What changed / Verification form, no attribution.
title: A collection reports the young bytes it was due at and its budget, and an exit reports its parks
